mapper.select: SELECT id, slug, name, icon, tagline, display_order FROM categories ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT m.id, m.category_id, m.model_key, m.name, m.provider, m.release_date, m.context_window, m.max_output, m.pricing_input, m.pricing_output, m.badge, m.tagline, m.display_order FROM llm_models m WHERE m.category_id = #{id} ORDER BY m.display_order ASC, m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (slug, name, icon, tagline, display_order) VALUES (#{slug}, #{name}, #{icon}, #{tagline}, #{displayOrder})
